title: SP3 Protein Cleanup with Rapizyme and ACN
author: Georgios Mermelekas
materials: Reconstitute the beads in 100 µL of digestion solution ( 50 millimolar (mM) HEPES pH 7.8 pH7.8±0.2, 10 millimolar (mM) CaCl 2 , 10 % (v/v) ACN, 4 µg Rapizyme (Waters)). Mix gently by pipetting. HEPES Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #H3375-500G (CAS: 7365-45-9) CaCl2 hexahydrate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #21108-500G (CAS: 7774-34-7) RapiZyme Trypsin, MS Grade, 4/pk (100ug) Waters Catalog #186010108
Determine peptide concentration with Bio-Rad Dcc. The BSA standard should be prepared in water.

steps.title: Prepare SP3 Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare and wash the Sera-Mag speed beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove two bottles of Sera-Mag speed beads from the fridge and let them reach room temperature for 10 minutes.
Shake both bottles gently (do not vortex) for approximately 5 minutes until beads are fully suspended.
Combine 50 µL of each bead type in a clean 1.5mL or 2mL Safe-lock Eppendorf tube.
Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 2 minutes, then remove and discard the supernatant.
Rinse the beads with 500 µL water by gentle pipette mixing (off the magnetic rack).
Repeat the wash (magnetic separation and rinse) two more times.
Re-suspend and store the beads in 500 µL water at 4 °C (stable for up to two weeks; do not freeze or sonicate; can be heated up to 60 °C).

steps.title: Prepare Reducing Reagent
steps.instruction: Freshly prepare a 100 mM aqueous solution of dithiothreitol (DTT).

substeps.instruction: Weigh approximately 1-2 mg (or one microspatula spoonful) of DTT powder.
Add the exact volume of water required to reach a final concentration of 100 mM (e.g., 1.5 mg / 154.253 mg/mmol ≈ 10 µmol dissolved in 100 µL water).
Vortex until dissolved and pulse-spin in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Prepare Alkylation Reagent
steps.instruction: Prepare a 200 mM aqueous solution of chloroacetamide (CAA).

substeps.instruction: Weigh approximately 7-8 mg (or four microspatula spoonfuls) of CAA powder.
Add the exact volume of water to reach a final concentration of 200 mM (e.g., 7.5 mg / 93.51 mg/mmol ≈ 80 µmol dissolved in 400 µL water).
Vortex until dissolved and pulse-spin in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare protein extract aliquots and normalize concentration.

substeps.instruction: Transfer an aliquot of protein extract containing 200 µg of proteins into a clean 2mL Eppendorf safelock tube.

Dilute the sample to a final volume of 200 µL (final protein concentration 1 µg/µL) using lysis buffer consisting of 4% (m/v) SDS (Merck MilliporeSigma #05030-500ML-F), 50 mM HEPES pH 7.8 ± 0.2 (Merck MilliporeSigma #H3375-500G), and 1 mM DTT (Merck MilliporeSigma #43815).

steps.title: Reduce and Alkylate Proteins
steps.instruction: Perform alkylation of the protein samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of 200 mM chloroacetamide to the sample to reach a final concentration of 10 mM.
Vortex to mix, spin down briefly, and incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Bind Proteins to Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the proteins to the SP3 beads using acetonitrile.

substeps.instruction: Add SP3 bead solution to the protein sample at a 1:10 ratio (e.g., 20 µL beads to 200 µL protein solution). Mix gently by pipetting.
Add acetonitrile (ACN) to achieve a final ACN composition of ≥ 70% (v/v) (e.g., 700 µL).
Incubate for 20 minutes in a continuously and gently rotating rack.
Place tubes in a magnetic rack for 2 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of 70% (v/v) EtOH, incubate for 30 seconds in the magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant. Repeat this wash once more.
Add 200 µL of neat ACN, incubate for 15 seconds in the magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant.
Air dry the beads for 30 seconds with the lid closed to avoid over-drying.

steps.title: Digest Proteins
steps.instruction: Perform enzymatic digestion of the proteins.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 16 hours at 37 °C with mild shaking in an oven-type incubator to avoid temperature gradients.

steps.title: Recover Peptides
steps.instruction: Release peptides from the beads and clean the final sample.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes in a magnetic rack for 2 minutes.
Remove tubes from the incubator, allow to cool to room temperature, and spin down briefly.
Discard the supernatant.
Incubate for 20 minutes in a continuously and gently rotating rack.
Add 1900 µL of ACN to reach a final content of > 95% (v/v) to ensure peptide binding/release dynamics.
Add 200 µL of neat ACN, incubate for 15 seconds in the magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant. Repeat this wash once more.
Add 200 µL of water, mix gently by brief vortex, and spin down.
Place on a magnetic rack for 2 minutes and transfer the supernatant to new 1.5mL tubes. Repeat this transfer step if proceeding directly to LCMS to ensure no bead carry-over.
